_about: Ballroom Quest syllabus. Steps are written for the LEADER: [foot, direction, beats, turn_degrees(+ = right), count_label, weight(optional, default true)]. The follower's part is the mirror image (other foot, forward<->back). Positions: closed, promenade, open, fan. A figure can follow another only if the free foot and the position match.

waltz.name: Waltz
waltz.feel: Rise and fall, 1-2-3 with the strongest step on 1. Swing and sway.

tango.name: Tango
tango.feel: Staccato, no rise and fall. Walks curve slightly left. Slow = 2 beats, quick = 1 beat.

foxtrot.name: Foxtrot
foxtrot.feel: Smooth, gliding Slow-Slow-Quick-Quick. Long walking slows, soft quicks.

chacha.name: Cha Cha
chacha.feel: Counted 2, 3, 4-and-1. Break steps on 2-3, a quick chasse on 4-and-1. Straight legs, Cuban motion.

rumba.name: Rumba
rumba.feel: Slow and sensual. Counted 2, 3, 4-1: the side step on 4 is held through 1.

jive.name: Jive
jive.feel: Bouncy and fast. Rock step on 1-2, chasse 3-a-4, chasse 5-a-6.

figures.name: Box Step
figures.lead_cue: Forward-side-close, back-side-close. Draw a square on the floor.
figures.follow_cue: Back-side-close, forward-side-close. Wait for the lead before the side step.
figures.mistake: Stepping side on 1 instead of forward; forgetting to close the feet on 3.

figures.name: Left Foot Closed Change
figures.lead_cue: Forward on the left, side, close. Use it to switch to a right-foot figure.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the right, side, close.
figures.mistake: Dancing it with a turn. It travels straight down the line of dance.

figures.name: Right Foot Closed Change
figures.lead_cue: Forward on the right, side, close. The bridge from a Natural Turn into a Reverse Turn.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the left, side, close.
figures.mistake: Skipping it and trying to start a Reverse Turn on the wrong foot.

figures.name: Natural Turn
figures.lead_cue: Right foot forward and start turning right. About 3/4 of a turn over six steps.
figures.follow_cue: Left foot back, heel turn on 2-3, then forward-side-close.
figures.mistake: Starting it with the left foot. A natural (right) turn always starts on the right foot for the leader.

figures.name: Reverse Turn
figures.lead_cue: Left foot forward and turn left. About 3/4 of a turn over six steps.
figures.follow_cue: Right foot back, heel turn, then forward-side-close.
figures.mistake: Following a Natural Turn directly. You need a Right Foot Closed Change in between.

figures.name: Whisk
figures.lead_cue: Forward, side, cross the left foot behind and open the follower into promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, cross the right foot behind as you turn your head right.
figures.mistake: Closing back to closed position after a Whisk. You end in promenade, so a Chasse from Promenade comes next.

figures.name: Chasse from Promenade
figures.lead_cue: Right foot through in promenade, then side-close-side to bring her back to closed.
figures.follow_cue: Left foot through, then turn to face him on side-close-side.
figures.mistake: Dancing it from closed position. It only starts from promenade (for example after a Whisk).

figures.name: Tango Walks
figures.lead_cue: Two slow walks, curving slightly left, feet placed with purpose.
figures.follow_cue: Two slow walks back, staying connected in the frame.
figures.mistake: Rising on the toes. Tango stays level.

figures.name: Basic (Walks + Tango Close)
figures.lead_cue: Slow, slow, quick, quick, slow. Draw the left foot in on the last slow without weight.
figures.follow_cue: Back, back, back, side, draw the right foot in without weight.
figures.mistake: Putting weight on the drawn foot. The same foot stays free for the next figure.

figures.name: Progressive Link
figures.lead_cue: Quick-quick: left forward, then right back as you snap into promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Right back, then left back as your head snaps to the right.
figures.mistake: Dancing a Closed Promenade without the Link first.

figures.name: Closed Promenade
figures.lead_cue: Slow side in promenade, quick through, quick side, slow close back to closed.
figures.follow_cue: Side, through, turn to face him, close.
figures.mistake: Starting it from closed position. It needs promenade (use a Progressive Link).

figures.name: Forward Basic
figures.lead_cue: Slow, slow, quick, quick: walk, walk, side, close.
figures.follow_cue: Back, back, side, close.
figures.mistake: Rushing the slows. Each slow is two full beats.

figures.name: Back Basic
figures.lead_cue: Back, back, side, close. Keep the frame toward your partner.
figures.follow_cue: Forward, forward, side, close.
figures.mistake: Looking down at the feet while going backward.

figures.name: Promenade
figures.lead_cue: Open to promenade, walk through, then side-close to come back to closed.
figures.follow_cue: Open to promenade, walk through with your left, side-close.
figures.mistake: Forgetting to close at the end. The quicks bring you back to closed position.

figures.name: Basic (forward half)
figures.lead_cue: Rock forward, replace, chasse to the left.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back, replace, chasse to the right.
figures.mistake: Starting the rock on 1. In cha cha the break step is on 2.

figures.name: Basic (back half)
figures.lead_cue: Rock back, replace, chasse to the right.
figures.follow_cue: Rock forward, replace, chasse to the left.
figures.mistake: Taking the chasse too big. Keep the side steps small.

figures.name: Basic (full)
figures.lead_cue: Forward half then back half. Ends with the left foot free.
figures.follow_cue: Back half then forward half.
figures.mistake: Going straight from a full Basic into a New Yorker. The New Yorker needs the right foot free.

figures.name: New Yorker
figures.lead_cue: Turn a quarter and check forward through side-by-side, replace, chasse back to face. Then the other side.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him: check forward with the left, replace, chasse.
figures.mistake: Checking with the wrong foot. The leader's first check is with the right foot.

figures.name: Hand to Hand
figures.lead_cue: Like a New Yorker, but you check BACK side by side, holding one hand.
figures.follow_cue: Check back with the left, side by side.
figures.mistake: Breaking forward instead of back.

figures.name: Underarm Turn
figures.lead_cue: Dance a back half while raising your left hand so she turns right under it.
figures.follow_cue: Forward, turn right under his arm on 3, chasse to face him.
figures.mistake: Leading the turn on the wrong foot: the leader needs the right foot free.

figures.name: Basic (forward half)
figures.lead_cue: Forward, replace, side and hold through 1.
figures.follow_cue: Back, replace, side and hold.
figures.mistake: Not holding the side step. 4-1 is two beats.

figures.name: Basic (back half)
figures.lead_cue: Back, replace, side and hold.
figures.follow_cue: Forward, replace, side and hold.
figures.mistake: Bouncing. Rumba stays grounded with hip action.

figures.name: Basic (full box)
figures.lead_cue: Forward half then back half. Ends with the left foot free.
figures.follow_cue: Back half then forward half.
figures.mistake: Following a full basic with a Fan. The Fan needs the right foot free.

figures.name: Fan
figures.lead_cue: Back half of the basic while you lead her out to your left into fan position.
figures.follow_cue: Forward, back, back as you turn away to his left side.
figures.mistake: Dancing a Fan from open position or with the wrong foot. It starts from closed with the right foot free.

figures.name: Hockey Stick
figures.lead_cue: From fan: forward, replace, close and raise your left hand; she turns under it.
figures.follow_cue: Close, forward, forward, then turn left under his arm.
figures.mistake: Dancing it from closed. A Hockey Stick only starts from fan position.

figures.name: Alemana
figures.lead_cue: From fan: forward, replace, close, then lead her to turn right under your arm back to closed.
figures.follow_cue: Close, forward, forward, then turn right under his arm.
figures.mistake: Trying it from open position after a Hockey Stick.

figures.name: New Yorker
figures.lead_cue: Quarter turn, check forward, replace, side. Then the other way.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him with your left foot first.
figures.mistake: Starting with the left foot. The leader needs the right foot free.

figures.name: Fallaway Rock
figures.lead_cue: Rock back, replace, chasse left, chasse right. Stay bouncy.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back, replace, chasse right, chasse left.
figures.mistake: Flat feet. Jive chasses are danced on the balls of the feet.

figures.name: Change of Place Right to Left
figures.lead_cue: Rock, then raise your left hand on 4 so she turns under it to your left side. You end apart.
figures.follow_cue: Rock, then turn right under his arm on the first chasse.
figures.mistake: Starting it from open position. It starts from closed; from open use Left to Right.

figures.name: Change of Place Left to Right
figures.lead_cue: Rock, then lead her to turn left under your arm while you turn right.
figures.follow_cue: Rock, then turn left under his arm.
figures.mistake: Dancing it from closed position. You need to be apart first (Right to Left).

figures.name: Change of Hands Behind Back
figures.lead_cue: Rock, then pass her right hand behind your back as you turn.
figures.follow_cue: Rock, then walk past him as he changes hands.
figures.mistake: Trying it from closed hold. You need open position.

figures.name: Link
figures.lead_cue: Rock, then draw her in with a forward chasse back to closed hold.
figures.follow_cue: Rock, then chasse forward into his arms.
figures.mistake: Forgetting to link. After open figures, the Link brings you back to closed.
